channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Man arrested on suspicion of murder after man found deceased on Curzon Road
item.description: Greater Manchester Police has arrested a man on suspicion of murder after a man was found deceased at an address on Curzon Road, Rochdale.

item.title: Mylos Steak & Grill set to arrive at Sandbrook Park in Rochdale
item.description: Mylos Steak & Grill is set to open at Sandbrook Park in Rochdale, although further details about the new restaurant have yet to be announced.

item.title: Denehurst Café launches weekly Remembrance & Reflection Walk for families and loved ones
item.description: Get Together After Serving CIC is inviting families and loved ones of fallen heroes to join a weekly Remembrance & Reflection Walk at Denehurst Park.

item.title: Sara Rowbotham: the Rochdale health worker who raised 181 safeguarding alerts
item.description: Sara Rowbotham repeatedly raised concerns about vulnerable young people while working for Rochdale’s Crisis Intervention Team, later giving evidence to Parliament about the response to child sexual exploitation in the town.

item.title: Restore Britain branch announces Burnley and Hyndburn event with Charlie Downes and Montgomery Toms
item.description: The Restore Britain Burnley & Hyndburn Branch has announced an evening event featuring guest speakers Charlie Downes and Montgomery Toms on Friday 16 October.

item.title: East Lancashire Railway to host first Event, Catering and Retail Volunteer Open Day
item.description: East Lancashire Railway is inviting prospective volunteers to its first Event, Catering and Retail Volunteer Open Day at Bury Bolton Street Station on Monday 12 October.

item.title: Sculpt & Edit launches wellness clinic after founder builds business from scratch
item.description: Sculpt & Edit founder Amy has opened a new wellness clinic after turning redundancy into an opportunity to build her own treatment business, with a focus on lymphatic drainage, post-surgery support and body treatments.

item.title: Birtle View Nursery opens at former Birtle site on Bury & Rochdale Old Road
item.description: Birtle View Nursery has opened at 239 Bury & Rochdale Old Road, with Mayor of Rochdale Councillor Faisal Rana attending the opening.

item.title: Rochdale’s Breaking Barriers secures core funding to expand its cultural work across Greater Manchester
item.description: Rochdale-based production company Breaking Barriers has secured three years of GMCA core funding to expand cultural programmes, paid opportunities and creative development across Greater Manchester.

item.title: New Awaab’s Law protections could cover millions more renters and vulnerable households
item.description: A government consultation will examine extending Awaab’s Law to private renters and other accommodation, with faster legal deadlines for landlords to tackle serious hazards such as damp and mould.

item.title: Why Rochdale says ‘cruckle’
item.description: Cruckle — the local verb for rolling or twisting an ankle — is a small word with deep dialect roots and a big place in Rochdale identity.

item.title: Rochdale Engineer Develops AI Prototype for Captioning Phone Conversations
item.description: A deaf engineer from Rochdale has created an AI prototype that provides real-time captions for phone conversations, enhancing accessibility for individuals with hearing impairments.

item.title: Rail Regulator Rejects Plans for New Rochdale to London Train Services
item.description: The Office of Rail and Road has rejected proposals for new train services between Rochdale and London Euston, citing concerns over delays and service reliability.

item.title: Mossylea Housing Development in Middleton Shortlisted for Two National Awards
item.description: First Choice Homes Oldham's £7.1 million Mossylea development in Middleton has been recognised as a finalist in two categories at the Inside Housing Awards, highlighting its commitment to affordable housing.

item.title: Construction Begins on New 103,770 sq ft Industrial Unit at Birch Business Park, Heywood
item.description: A new urban logistics unit, Birch 100, is under construction at Birch Business Park in Heywood, expected to enhance local industrial operations and create jobs by summer 2027.

item.title: Rochdale Council Proposes Investment in Education and Inclusion Services
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has put forward a proposal to invest in central schools services funding aimed at enhancing statutory education and inclusion across the borough.

item.title: Rochdale AFC to Support Play Safe Campaign This Weekend
item.description: Rochdale AFC will participate in the Play Safe campaign this weekend, promoting safety in youth football. The initiative aims to raise awareness about safeguarding in the sport.

item.title: From historic chapel to bridal sanctuary: Orla Bridal celebrates its launch in Mytholmroyd
item.description: A new independent bridal boutique has opened in one of Mytholmroyd’s historic buildings, bringing a new chapter of celebration to The Chapel on Scout Road.

item.title: 590 Bus Service from Rochdale to Halifax Showcases Scenic Pennine Journey
item.description: The 590 bus service from Rochdale to Halifax offers passengers a picturesque view of Greater Manchester's industrial heritage and beautiful landscapes for just £2.50.

item.title: East Lancashire Railway wins Community Hero Award for its volunteers
item.description: East Lancashire Railway has been recognised with a Roch Valley Radio Community Hero Award for the contribution of its more than 800 volunteers.

item.title: Rochdale Sleepout 2026 returns to raise funds and awareness for people facing homelessness
item.description: Petrus is calling on Rochdale residents, businesses and community groups to get behind Rochdale Sleepout 2026 and help raise vital funds for local people experiencing homelessness and social exclusion.

item.title: Rochdale Masters and Mayfield Movers take on 45-mile charity walk
item.description: Rochdale Masters and Mayfield Movers are taking on a 45-mile charity walk on Saturday, 31 October, to raise money for four causes close to their hearts.

item.title: New Years Eve with the Jäger Maestros
item.description: The irrepressible Jager Maestros return to Littleborough CC to get you swaying, singing, dancing and drinking the Nee Year in. 🍻🥨🇩🇪 Doors open at 8pm and the show starts at 9pm. Littleborough Cricket Club, Littleborough OL15 9LD, UK

item.title: Littleborough Cricket Club Bonfire 2026
item.description: 🎆 Fireworks • Food & Drink • Fun Fair 🎡 ✨ Children 2 and under go free 👨‍👩‍👧 All children must be accompanied by an adult. Child tickets apply to anyone under 18. 🕓 Gates Open: 16:00 🔥 Bonfire Lit: 17:30 Littleborough, Denhurst Rd, Littleborough OL15 9LD, UK

item.title: Brass and Bublé: A Christmas Special
item.description: Experience all the festive charm and smooth vocals of the Canadian Crooner, brought to life by an outstanding tribute act, accompanied by the brilliant Wardle Anderson Brass Band. Rochdale, Town Hall, The Esplanade, Rochdale OL16 1AZ, UK

item.title: Wonders Of Our Universe. The Next Chapter
item.description: 🪐 Step into a world of wonder with Wonders of Our Universe – The Next Chapter. Join astrophysicist Ian Hall FRAS for a brand-new journey deeper into space and time: breathtaking visuals, captivating storytelling and atmospheric live music. Perfect for returning fans and first-time explorers alike. Rochdale, Champness H

item.title: Boy, 13, stabbed in Rochdale town centre: six arrested, two bailed and stop-and-search powers extended
item.description: Live story. Six teenage boys have now been arrested after a 13-year-old was stabbed in Rochdale town centre on Saturday night. Two have been released on bail, four remain in custody, and Section 60 stop-and-search powers in the town centre run until 3pm on Tuesday. Updated as Greater Manchester Police confirm developments.

item.title: Milnrow's John Milne Table Table to close on September 3
item.description: John Milne Table Table in Milnrow will close on 3 September, with the restaurant thanking generations of customers for their support and inviting guests to visit once more.

item.title: One in seven Rochdale businesses could be overpaying business rates, research claims
item.description: More than 1,300 commercial properties in Rochdale could be paying too much in business rates, with potential overpayments worth a combined £2.9 million a year, according to BusinessRateChecker.com.

item.title: REFORM UK DELIVERS: PEOPLE POWER BACKED BY REFORM SCRAPS DISASTROUS ROAD CLOSURES!
item.description: Heywood Township councillors have voted unanimously to end the Hopwood Triangle traffic trial after sustained opposition from residents, while the Coronation Avenue HGV parking restriction will remain.

item.title: From teaching assistant to PT: how Rochdale mum Jen Daker found the strongest version of herself
item.description: After 16 years in education, mum-of-two Jen Daker has found a new calling as a personal trainer at The Hybrid Hut in Rochdale, combining 4am discipline, family life and a passion for helping others build confidence.

item.title: Oliver Coldman crowned champion golfer at Rochdale Golf Club Captain’s Final
item.description: Oliver Coldman has won Rochdale Golf Club’s 2026 Captain’s Final with a two-round total of 133, four shots ahead of runner-up Steve Royle.

item.title: New HALO Hair & Beauty salon to open on Shawclough Road
item.description: HALO Hair & Beauty is preparing to open at 34a Shawclough Road on 1 September, with appointments already available to book and the new salon showcasing its first treatments.

item.title: Rochdale AFC installs 26 male sanitary bins to support fans after prostate cancer treatment
item.description: Rochdale AFC has installed 26 specially designed male incontinence bins at the Crown Oil Arena and joined Prostate Cancer UK and phs Group's BOG STANDARD Charter through the Back in the Game campaign.

item.title: Rock Classics by Candlelight, Rochdale
item.description: 🎻 Strings of Fire — a classical string quartet like you’ve never seen before! Blending stunning strings with rock classics, electro sounds and high-energy performance, this is classical music with attitude. All in the stunning setting of Rochdale Town Hall 🔥🤘 Rochdale, Town Hall, The Esplanade, Rochdale OL16 1AZ, UK

item.title: WellMental UK hosts first men's mental health fitness session in Heywood
item.description: WellMental UK held its first session in Heywood on Friday evening, combining fitness, food and conversation to support men's mental health.

item.title: Norden Cricket Club festival brings community together today
item.description: Norden Cricket Club's festival has been taking place today, with Rochdale Daily wishing everyone attending a fantastic evening of entertainment.

item.title: Driver arrested after stolen vehicle recovered on Milnrow Road in Rochdale
item.description: A driver has been arrested after Rochdale neighbourhood officers stopped a vehicle on Milnrow Road that police say had been reported stolen from North Wales.

item.title: Rochdale Foodbank appeals for this week's most-needed items
item.description: Rochdale Foodbank is asking residents to donate Tampax, rice, noodles, juice and snacks as part of its latest weekly appeal.

item.title: Wildfire emergency alert: an overreaction, or a sign of things to come?
item.description: Millions of phones across England and Wales sounded a Government Emergency Alert as wildfire risk reached exceptional levels. Was the intrusive warning proportionate, or are Britons being introduced to a hazard we will increasingly have to live with?

item.title: Homelessness, addiction and the cruelty of public condemnation
item.description: A disabled homeless man outside Tesco Express on Whitworth Road has become the subject of photographs, insults and jokes online. The harder question is whether public humiliation solves anything at all.

item.title: URGENT: Police appeal to find missing 10-year-old Rayah in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police has launched an urgent appeal to find 10-year-old Rayah, who was last seen on Bower Avenue in Rochdale at around 8.30am today.

item.title: Rochdale businesses urged to back Denehurst House in £30-a-month veterans challenge
item.description: A Rochdale veterans support organisation is asking 100 local businesses to pledge £30 a month to help keep Denehurst House operational and support former service personnel in need.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Netball launched as Rochdale Netball Club joins Dale family
item.description: Rochdale Netball Club is becoming Rochdale AFC Netball in a new partnership with Rochdale AFC and its Community Trust, bringing nearly 200 weekly players into the club's wider sporting family.

item.title: LIVE: Murder ruled out as investigation continues into death of Nathan Haigh in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police has ruled out murder as a line of enquiry into the death of 31-year-old Nathan Haigh at Great Howarth, while enquiries into the circumstances continue.

item.title: A-Level results day: Rochdale students discover what comes next
item.description: Students across Rochdale are receiving their A-Level results today, as the town's sixth form record comes under the spotlight and Rochdale MP Paul Waugh begins his new role at the Department for Education.

item.title: No trains between Rochdale and Manchester Victoria this week as replacement buses run
item.description: Passengers travelling between Rochdale and Manchester Victoria are being advised to allow extra time this week, with trains replaced by buses from Monday 10 to Friday 14 August.

item.title: £12m plan aims to bring Storage World Middleton site back to life after devastating fire
item.description: A £12m rebirth bid has been launched for the Storage World site in Middleton, more than a year after a devastating fire destroyed the Old Hall Street facility.

item.title: Summer makeover under way at St Mary’s CE Primary School in Rochdale
item.description: St Mary’s CE Primary School in Rochdale is undergoing a summer makeover, with improvement works taking place in the school hall and reception classroom ahead of the new term.

item.title: Can’t make it to church? Christ Church Healey invites community to join Sunday service online
item.description: Christ Church Healey is inviting people who cannot attend in person, are new to church or simply want to find out more to join its Sunday morning service online each week.
